name: Demnadi
description: Demnadi was a Mid Rim planet located in the Far Xandil sector. During the Galactic Civil War, a planet-wide riot, believed by the Imperial Governor Cathers to have been instigated by local Rebel Alliance factions, erupted at Demnadi. In response, the Empire dispatched the CompForce Demnadi Relief Operation, which consisted of just one man, Major Fenris Sarhl, to pacify the planet.
